executiveSummary: All six functional requirements and all five user stories for iteration 000001 are fully satisfied. The monorepo layout, Bun-driven gateway (Elysia), uv-driven Python worker (FastAPI/Uvicorn/Pydantic), dotenvx-based local configuration, example env templates (placeholders only), HTTP health endpoints on both services, and README stack-table/manifest alignment are all present and correctly implemented. Minor observations concern the absence of committed lock files (bun.lockb/bun.lock and uv.lock) and a soft cross-package dependency in the worker's dotenvx invocation path.
minorObservations: Lock files (bun.lockb/bun.lock for the gateway and uv.lock for the worker) are not visible in the repository. Without committed lock files, installs are not fully reproducible across machines. These files should be committed unless there is a documented policy not to.

The dotenvx CLI invocation for the worker (README section 'Secrets and local environment') references gateway/node_modules/.bin/dotenvx, creating an implicit cross-package dependency: the gateway must be installed before the worker can use dotenvx. This coupling is documented but is easy to miss. A note in the worker .env.example or a standalone install recommendation could clarify the prerequisite.
The worker .env.example has no trailing newline before the first comment line (cosmetic; some editors or POSIX tools flag this).
conclusionsAndRecommendations: The iteration 000001 implementation is production-ready for its stated Phase 1 scope. All PRD requirements are met with no gaps. Recommended follow-up actions: (1) Commit bun.lockb/bun.lock and uv.lock to the repository to guarantee reproducible dependency installs. (2) Consider adding a brief note in worker/.env.example or in the README prerequisites section clarifying that gateway/ must be installed first for the dotenvx CLI to be available when loading worker/.env. Both items are low-effort and improve developer onboarding quality.
